gancho: In old Hawaiʻi, souls leaped from the cliffs into the dark land of Milu. One young man covered himself in rotten oil, climbed down a vine, and tricked the lord of the dead to bring back the woman he loved.
Sources: Martha Beckwith, Hawaiian Mythology (1940); W. D. Westervelt, Legends of Gods and Ghosts (1915); Samuel Kamakau.
capitulos: A plan to bring her back
